title: What came between Sultanate of Muscat and Sultanate of Zanzibar?
question: What came between Sultanate of Muscat and Sultanate of Zanzibar?
claim: 2 documented links lead from Sultanate of Muscat (1650) to Sultanate of Zanzibar (1856): 0 of cause and effect, 2 of succession.
why: Each record is joined to the one before it by a Wikidata statement (has effect, has cause, followed by, follows, replaced by, replaces), and the dates run forward. The longest such chain from the first record was taken, preferring cause and effect.
